title: Stale pre-5.10 narrow-capacity prose in routing_cost_test bundle-cap comments and assertion message
detail: The bundle-cap comments and failure message still cite narrow capacity 5; post-5.10 the member sum is 10+40=50. The assertion itself reads cat.pipe_tiers[narrow].capacity_units, so it passes while the docs misstate the value the PR changed.
recommended_fix: Update lines 233, 291, 295 to '(narrow 10 + wide 40)' / '(10+40)' — comment/message text only, no golden churn.

title: catalog.odin cap doc still claims '~2× access headroom' — now 4× after the 5.10 rebalance
evidence: // sources ≤ 0.083 pkts/tick = 2.5 u/s (half its 5 u/s, ~2× access headroom),
detail: The 5.9 cap doc's access-headroom figure derives from narrow capacity (5÷2.5=2×); this PR's 5→10 change makes it 10÷2.5=4×. Pre-existing line, but this diff's data change makes the canon comment wrong.
recommended_fix: Amend to '~4× access headroom post-5.10 (narrow 10 u/s)' — comment-only in core, catalog_hash folds data/*.json bytes not source comments, golden-neutral.

title: health_catalog_fast_grace's 380 is now dead — its only caller overrides to 200
detail: After the 5.10 E16 re-pin, the helper's sole caller (test_health_drain_max_not_sum_e16) sets 200 inline after calling the helper, so the 380 assignment has no effect anywhere in the suite — misleading layering for future editors.
recommended_fix: Fold the 200 into health_catalog_fast_grace (update its doc comment), or drop the helper call and set grace 200 once inline.

title: W11 port-budget comment miscounts the b-side — rb runs at exactly 8/8, not 7
evidence:
// the shared link is). router_mid ports: 6 res + uplink = 7 <= 8 per side.
...
	sla_draw(&s, cat, host, rb, "wide", 1)   // pipe 12 — the host drop
	sla_draw(&s, cat, ra, rb, "standard", 1) // pipe 13 — the shared uplink
detail: The '6 res + uplink = 7' arithmetic holds only for ra; rb carries 6 res drops + the host wide drop + the shared uplink = 8 incident pipes = exactly port_capacity 8, leaving no spare. The comment misleads future fixture edits (a new rb leg would be rejected).
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to note the b-side is 6 res + host + uplink = 8/8 (at capacity).
